

You can configure server settings, such as the port number, whether to allow other API clients to access the server and MCP features.

data="-%20name%3A%20Server%20Port%0A%20%20type%3A%20Integer%0A%20%20optional%3A%20false%0A%20%20description%3A%20Port%20number%20on%20which%20the%20LM%20Studio%20API%20server%20listens%20for%20incoming%20connections.%0A%20%20unstyledName%3A%20true%0A-%20name%3A%20Require%20Authentication%0A%20%20type%3A%20Switch%0A%20%20description%3A%20Require%20API%20clients%20to%20provide%20a%20valid%20API%20token%20via%20the%20%60Authorization%60%20header.%20Learn%20more%20in%20the%20%5BAuthentication%5D(%2Fdocs%2Fdeveloper%2Fcore%2Fauthentication)%20section.%0A%20%20unstyledName%3A%20true%0A-%20name%3A%20Serve%20on%20Local%20Network%0A%20%20type%3A%20Switch%0A%20%20description%3A%20Allow%20other%20devices%20on%20the%20same%20local%20network%20to%20access%20the%20API%20server.%20Learn%20more%20in%20the%20%5BServe%20on%20Local%20Network%5D(%2Fdocs%2Fdeveloper%2Fcore%2Fserver%2Fserve-on-network)%20section.%0A%20%20unstyledName%3A%20true%0A-%20name%3A%20Allow%20per-request%20MCPs%0A%20%20type%3A%20Switch%0A%20%20description%3A%20Allow%20API%20clients%20to%20use%20MCP%20(Model%20Context%20Protocol)%20servers%20that%20are%20not%20in%20your%20mcp.json.%20These%20MCP%20connections%20are%20ephemeral%2C%20only%20existing%20as%20long%20as%20the%20request.%20At%20the%20moment%2C%20only%20remote%20MCPs%20are%20supported.%0A%20%20unstyledName%3A%20true%0A-%20name%3A%20Allow%20calling%20servers%20from%20mcp.json%0A%20%20type%3A%20Switch%0A%20%20description%3A%20Allow%20API%20clients%20to%20use%20servers%20you%20defined%20in%20your%20mcp.json%20in%20LM%20Studio.%20This%20can%20be%20a%20security%20risk%20if%20you've%20defined%20MCP%20servers%20that%20have%20access%20to%20your%20file%20system%20or%20private%20data.%20This%20option%20requires%20%22Require%20Authentication%22%20to%20be%20enabled.%0A%20%20unstyledName%3A%20true%0A-%20name%3A%20Enable%20CORS%0A%20%20type%3A%20Switch%0A%20%20description%3A%20Enable%20Cross-Origin%20Resource%20Sharing%20(CORS)%20to%20allow%20applications%20from%20different%20origins%20to%20access%20the%20API.%0A%20%20unstyledName%3A%20true%0A-%20name%3A%20Just%20in%20Time%20Model%20Loading%0A%20%20type%3A%20Switch%0A%20%20description%3A%20Load%20models%20dynamically%20at%20request%20time%20to%20save%20memory.%0A%20%20unstyledName%3A%20true%0A-%20name%3A%20Auto%20Unload%20Unused%20JIT%20Models%0A%20%20type%3A%20Switch%0A%20%20description%3A%20Automatically%20unload%20JIT-loaded%20models%20from%20memory%20when%20they%20are%20no%20longer%20in%20use.%0A%20%20unstyledName%3A%20true%0A-%20name%3A%20Only%20Keep%20Last%20JIT%20Loaded%20Model%0A%20%20type%3A%20Switch%0A%20%20description%3A%20Keep%20only%20the%20most%20recently%20used%20JIT-loaded%20model%20in%20memory%20to%20minimize%20RAM%20usag%0A%20%20unstyledName%3A%20true"
